title: Procore Endpoint Structured Analytics Foundation + Daily-Brief Usefulness Package
primary_objective: Implement durable local Procore endpoint data capture in structured analytics-grade tables, with raw/local business content preserved for future analytics and downstream local-model/daily-brief projections.
non_goals: Do not make the daily brief the owner of the Procore data model.
Do not store only generic unqueryable JSON blobs as the analytics foundation.
Do not commit raw Procore payloads or private DB extracts.
Do not perform Procore, Graph, email, calendar, SharePoint, or MCP writeback.
